title: D3 clinical-mechanism honesty gate -- efficacy of real therapies is cited [L], never derived
firewall: the R19 kernel DERIVES a treatment DIRECTION/CLASS (basin/lever); the CLINICAL EFFICACY of a real therapy is EXTERNAL cited biology [L] and the molecule/dose/patient-response is [O]. The kernel does not derive a clinical effect.

lever_A.clinical_anchor: APL: ATRA + arsenic trioxide (differentiation, non-cytotoxic) -> >90% cure [L]
lever_A.grade: [V] threshold forced = spinodal / [L] clinical anchor / [O] molecule-level mapping

lever_B.clinical_anchor: tumor-suppressor / epigenetic normalization (e.g. restoring p53-axis control) [L-class]
lever_B.grade: [V] exponential shape forced by Kramers / [O] absolute factor (kT uncalibrated)

lever_C.clinical_anchor: carcinogen cessation (benzene removal, smoking cessation); antiviral for oncovirus (EBV/HBV) -> future risk falls, established disease persists [L]

lever_D.clinical_anchor: checkpoint blockade (anti-PD-1/PD-L1) and CAR-T -> curative in refractory leukemia/lymphoma (this package's domain) [L]
lever_D.grade: [V] burden falls at fixed crossing-rate; cross-cutting multiplier forced by T5 / [L] CAR-T & checkpoint anchors / [O] response heterogeneity
